description: Create a new dashboard named 'Facility Kiosk' that serves as a navigation hub. 1. Find the existing dashboards named 'Solar Array A', 'HVAC Main', and 'Lighting Zones' and note their Dashboard IDs. 2. Create a new dashboard named 'Facility Kiosk'. 3. Add a 'Text' (or Paragraph/HTML) widget to this new dashboard. 4. Configure the widget to display a navigation menu containing links to all three dashboards. The links must point to the correct Dashboard IDs (e.g., using HTML anchor tags like Solar). 5. Save the dashboard.
